proof_summary: Define an auxiliary sequence \(L_0=2, L_1=1, L_{n+2}=L_{n+1}-4L_n\) and set \(Y_n=2^{2n+1}L_{n+1}\). Algebra shows that both the odd subsequence \(a_{2n+1}\) and \(Y_n^2\) satisfy the same third-order recurrence \(X_{n+3}=-48X_{n+2}+3072X_{n+1}+262144X_n\); their first three values agree, so induction gives \(a_{2n+1}=Y_n^2\) for all \(n\).
